name: Landgasthof-Pension Ledererwirt
beschreibung: Landgasthof-Pension Ledererwirt welcomes vacationers to the village of Ebbs in the lower Inn Valley. Located at the foot of the dramatic Kaisergebirge and close to the fortress town of Kufstein, this family-managed inn radiates genuine Tyrolean comfort. Well-kept country-style guest rooms feature private balconies overlooking the rugged limestone peaks. The welcoming tavern parlor with its traditional tiled stove serves hearty Tyrolean dishes and seasonal specialties prepared with regional ingredients. The property is ideally positioned for hikes into the Kaisertal Valley, visits to the renowned Haflinger stud farm Fohlenhof, and skiing at Zahmer Kaiser.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional country inn and guesthouse in Ebbs at the foot of the Kaisergebirge offering Tyrolean warmth.
